Ordered identification and convexity Several authors have defined identification functions for real-valued properties to have an additional order-sensitive quality, requiring v(r, p) > 0 ⇐⇒ r > Γ(p) (Lambert et al., 2008; Lambert, 2011; Steinwart et al., 2014). Notably, the corresponding characterizations then force the weights λ(r) to be nonnegative. At first glance, there does not appear to be a natural notion of order-sensitivity for vector-valued properties. Here we propose such a notion, using Γ to determine the order. The key idea follows from Proposition 18.
